The tour was extremely interesting and gave a great insight into how many different industries work side by side. We saw how plastic is sorted and crushed, how electronic waste is separated into different materials, and how fabrics are dyed, ironed, and sewn into clothing. featured_reviews.name: 光頭小伍
featured_reviews.review_text:
走進孟買的心臟，你會來到一個讓世界又震撼又敬佩的地方——Dharavi。這裡面積僅約1.75平方公里，卻容納了數十萬人口，是亞洲最密集的社區之一。但如果你只用「貧民窟」來定義它，那就太小看這裡了。

在狹窄巷弄之間，藏著驚人的經濟能量。回收、皮革、紡織、陶器，一間間小工坊日夜運轉，創造出數億美元的產值，產品甚至銷往世界各地。這裡沒有華麗辦公室，卻有最真實的創業精神；沒有資源優勢，卻用雙手打造無限可能。

來自印度各地的人們在此落腳，不同語言、宗教與文化交織，形成獨特的生命力。儘管面對擁擠與衛生挑戰，他們依然努力生活、努力工作，用韌性撐起整個城市的運轉。

達拉維不是悲情的象徵，而是一面鏡子，讓人看見人在困境中依然可以發光。走一趟，你會重新理解什麼叫做努力，什麼叫做希望。
featured_reviews.review_translated_text:
Step into the heart of Mumbai, and you'll find a place that both shocks and inspires awe—Dharavi. Spanning only about 1.75 square kilometers, it houses hundreds of thousands of people, making it one of the most densely populated communities in Asia. But to define it merely as a "slum" would be a gross underestimation.

Hidden within its narrow alleyways is an astonishing economic energy. Recycling, leather, textiles, pottery—small workshops operate day and night, generating hundreds of millions of dollars in revenue, with products sold worldwide. Here, there are no glamorous offices, but the most genuine entrepreneurial spirit; no resource advantages, but limitless possibilities created with their own hands.

People from all over India have settled here, their diverse languages, religions, and cultures intertwining to create a unique vitality. Despite facing overcrowding and sanitation challenges, they persevere, working hard and resiliently keeping the city running.

Dharavi is not a symbol of tragedy, but a mirror reflecting the light that shines even in adversity. A visit will give you a new understanding of the meaning of hard work and hope.

From start to finish, both Sir and Madam stayed in constant touch with us. They were always available to solve any queries instantly from the initial inquiry until the trip ended. I had a wonderful experience and highly suggest everyone book their next trip with them.

featured_reviews.name: vidula raut
featured_reviews.review_text:
Our Kashmir trip with Dream Round Tours and Travels was amazing. We were able to cover almost every kind of beauty Kashmir offers — snow, tulip garden, waterfalls, and greenery. We were also lucky to experience unexpected snowfall at Gulmarg, which made our trip even more memorable and magical. The travel arrangements were smooth, and the hotel stay was comfortable. Everything was well managed, making the trip relaxing and enjoyable.
A special thanks to our driver Mr. Mehraj, who truly made our trip even better. He took us to some extra beautiful places and guided us at every location. He also helped us with bargaining at local markets and always made sure we were comfortable.
Truly a well-organized and memorable trip.
Thank you Dream round tours and travels 🥳🎉

featured_reviews.review_text: It was an amazing trip enjoy at kullu Manali and Shimla...It was a fantastic experience with dream round tours and travels...we enjoy lot of things and many more adventures...we carried lots of memories with us..thank you so much heena madam and team for organized this wonderful trip for us..

featured_reviews.review_text: We planned a trip to Shimla, Kullu, and Manali from November 30, 2025, to December 5, 2025, through Dream Round Tours and Travels. We would like to plan our next trip with Dream Round Tours and Travels very soon.

featured_reviews.name: Note from Travelam
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had an amazing experience with Mumbai Dream Tours! A special thanks to Hardhik, who made this journey truly memorable with his incredible knowledge, guidance, and hospitality throughout the tour.

The 3-hour trek was one of the most unique experiences in Mumbai, covering iconic places like the world’s largest open-air laundry at Dhobi Ghat, the fascinating Dabbawala system, and the vibrant life of Dharavi. Hardhik explained every detail with so much passion and insight, making the entire experience engaging and meaningful.

What stood out the most was how comfortable and well-guided we felt throughout the tour. It was not just sightseeing, but a real understanding of Mumbai’s culture, people, and hardworking spirit.

Highly recommended for anyone visiting Mumbai and wanting to explore the city beyond the usual tourist spots. Thank you once again, Hardhik and Mumbai Dream Tours, for such a wonderful experience!

featured_reviews.name: Danna Katzman
featured_reviews.review_text: We went on the Dharavi Slum Tour with Rakesh as our guide. It was intense, overwhelming, and inspiring all at once. Rakesh was wonderful - very knowledgeable and willing to answer all our many questions. He took us through the bustling commercial area first and then we also saw a crowded residential area. This tour really makes you think about ones own privilege, the ways many people in this world have to live, and the how they find opportunities to thrive. Highly recommend this tour.

featured_reviews.name: Shebin Cp
featured_reviews.review_text: Had a wonderful experience with Mumbai Dream Tours. Hardik’s communication and service were excellent, and the overall experience was smooth and enjoyable. Truly appreciated the professionalism and support throughout.

featured_reviews.name: Felicitas
featured_reviews.review_text:
The tour with Abhi was one of the absolute highlights of my time in Mumbai: insightful, respectful and so much more than a typical city tour. Abhi guides you through Dhobi Ghat and Dharavi with calmness and authenticity, explains social and economic contexts, shares stories from the community and manages to convey a complex reality. I learned so many new things!
Also I felt safe and well taken care of at all times, and the tour genuinely moved me. If you’re looking for a tour that not only provides information but also real insight and connection, Abhi is the perfect guide.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:

It means a great deal to us that you found the experience insightful, respectful, and deeply moving. Abhi takes immense pride in presenting Dhobi Ghat and Dharavi with authenticity, sensitivity, and context, and your words perfectly reflect the values we strive to uphold. We’re especially glad to hear that you felt safe, well cared for, and genuinely connected to the community and its stories.

Your recommendation is incredibly appreciated, and we’re grateful you chose Mumbai Dream Tours for such an important experience. We hope to welcome you back again to explore more of Mumbai’s many layers.

Warm regards,
Mumbai Dream Tours Team

featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a fantastic few hours on the market tour with Akash. We visited many different market and shopping areas as well as the cow sanctuary, and Akash was very informative throughout.

I decided on the tour at the last minute and Dinesh Jain at Mumbai Dream tours was prompt in replying to my enquiries and arranging the tour.

I would happily use this tour company again should I return to Mumbai.

featured_reviews.name: Lukovenko Elena
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had an amazing experience exploring Dhobi Ghat and Dharavi with Rakesh as my guide. From the very beginning, he was warm, professional, and incredibly knowledgeable.
At Dhobi Ghat, Rakesh explained the fascinating open-air laundry system, about how the workers operate, the history behind the place, and how the system functions so efficiently even today.
During the Dharavi tour, Rakesh gave us a completely different and eye-opening perspective. He respectfully showed the strong sense of community, entrepreneurship, and hard work that define the area. His explanations about the various small-scale industries, recycling processes, and daily life were so inspiring! I truly appreciated how he conducted the tour with sensitivity and respect for the local residents.
Rakesh answered all my questions, and made sure I felt comfortable... Thanks to him, the experience was not just a tour, but a meaningful learning journey.
I highly recommend Rakesh to anyone visiting Dhobi Ghat and Dharavi — you will leave with a much deeper understanding and appreciation of these incredible places!

featured_reviews.name: Mario VP (Rio)
featured_reviews.review_text: We had a great time checking out Mumbai's famous landmarks, and Rakesh was an amazing guide. He explained everything clearly and shared some fascinating historical stories along the way. The Mumbai Dream Tour team was also really quick to respond and helpful during the planning. Plus, the price for the private tour with pick-up was really reasonable for tourists like us. Definitely worth it!
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you so much for your kind words! We’re delighted to know you enjoyed exploring Mumbai’s landmarks with Rakesh and found his stories engaging. It’s also great to hear that our team’s support and tour arrangements made your experience smooth and enjoyable. We truly appreciate your recommendation and hope to welcome you back on another Mumbai Dream Tour soon!
